_comment: Hermes (Nous Research) MCP server config. Drop the `mnesio` entry into your Hermes `mcp_servers` config (Hermes auto-reloads on change). Build first: `cargo build -p mnesio-mcp --release`. Point MNESIO_DATA at a persistent dir to keep memory across runs; share the same dir across agents to share memory. Hermes' selective tool-loading can expose a subset of the three tools.
